Definition: from G435; manly; Andreas, an Israelite:--Andrew.
BiblicalUsage: Andrew is Simon Peter's brother, a fisherman of Bethsaida, and the first of the apostles to follow Jesus. He brings his brother to Christ, and later he brings the boy with the five loaves and two fishes, always quietly bringing someone to Jesus.
TheologicalSignificance: Andrew never takes the centre of the story, and I love him for it: his work is bringing people to Jesus and then stepping back. I believe the kingdom runs on men like him, faithful in the introductions no one remembers.
RelatedEvents: The Calling of the First Disciples; The Feeding of the Five Thousand
